# The Byte Office

The Byte Office is a software development and AI solutions company.

Website: https://thebyteoffice.com
Contact: thebyteoffice@gmail.com

Core services:
- Custom software development
- Full-stack web application development
- SaaS platform development
- Backend systems and API development
- AI agents and LLM applications
- Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems
- Automation solutions
- Cloud-ready business software
- Data pipelines and integrations

Portfolio highlights:
- Cyberlooper.ai: secure chat platform for AI agents with LangGraph orchestration.
- Retail Sales Digital Dashboard: internal analytics and geospatial operations dashboard.
- Regenerative Aesthetics Web App: conversion-focused clinic website with booking and lead capture.
- Sales Automation Pipeline: Pipedrive-connected lead intake and follow-up automation.
- WhatsApp Bot for Multi-Site Deployment: reusable website chat automation for lead capture.
- Skiing Analysis via Computer Vision: pose estimation and movement analysis.
- Legislative AI Assistant with RAG: document-grounded legal and policy assistant.
